text:
maya: Quick question — onboarding AcmeCorp's Private VPC observability. Where do I look for their metrics/logs/traces? Need Grafana access + Prom remote_write example and OTLP endpoint if we have one.

raj: For AcmeCorp we usually set up a dedicated Grafana org: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ACME/acmecorp-overview — ping me for org invite. Metrics can be pushed via remote_write to our ingest endpoint if they opted in: https://push.redwood-infer.internal/api/v1/prom/remote_write?org=acme
Traces come to our OTLP receiver at otlp-acme.redwood-infer.internal:4317 (gRPC) or :55680 (http/protobuf). Logs are forwarded via Vector to either our S3 bucket or to their managed Grafana Loki depending on the customer's preference.

zach: Prom remote_write example (give to customers):
```
remote_write:
  - url: "https://push.redwood-infer.internal/api/v1/prom/remote_write?org=acme"
    bearer_token: "${PROM_REMOTE_WRITE_TOKEN}"
    write_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: "(up|process_.*)"
        action: keep
```
And OTLP Collector exporter snippet for our endpoint:
```
exporters:
  otlp/redwood:
    endpoint: "otlp-acme.redwood-infer.internal:4317"
    tls:
      insecure: false
```

maya: who sets up the Grafana org and tokens? I don't have perms.

raj: I can create the org + service account. I'll need the customer's RBAC needs (viewer/editor) and whether they want dashboard pinning. @zach can create a service token via grafana-cli and hand it to you.

observability-bot: Runbook: Private VPC observability onboarding — https://wiki.redwood/infrarunbooks/private-vpc-observability. Contains checklist: nginx certs, firewall rules, prometheus relabels, OTLP port list, log-forwarder config.

maya: Also seeing noisy alerts during initial scrape — what's our guidance for tuning? Rule 132 (series growth) kept firing.

zach: For onboarding, bump 'for' to 15m and add a cardinality cap in the rule labels. If it's a customer-side metric causing noise, ask them to add relabeling to drop high-cardinality labels. We can delay sending alert notifications for 24-48h while onboarding to avoid pager fatigue. I can add an alert inhibition rule for that customer.

maya: perfect, thanks — will collect the RBAC request and share with raj.

raj: I'll start the org creation now and post the grafana invite once done. :thumbsup:
